description: Water Hydrants is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bundaberg Regional Council Open Data. Before You Dig information provided to assist in avoiding damaging assets as a result of digging or excavation works. Coverage: Bundaberg Regional Council Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher Bundaberg Regional Council Open Data. Its tags are bundaberg, byda, electrical, stormwater, wastewater. It offers 11 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, gdb, geojson, gpkg. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
